brief:
Bank of Palestine participated in the launch of a green economy financing program by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), according to Maan Wire. The initiative aims to support sustainable economic projects in the Palestinian territories through dedicated funding mechanisms.

The program represents an effort to channel investment toward environmentally responsible development, with the Palestinian financial institution playing a key role in implementation at the local level.
title: Palestinian bank joins European lender's green finance program launch
